item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Hints At A Big Doctor Doom And [SPOILER] Twist
item.description: The latest Avengers: Doomsday rumour suggests we can expect a big Victor Von Doom twist, specifically relating to another key location from the wider Multiverse Saga.

item.title: NIGHTWING: 6 Actors Who Could Play Dick Grayson In James Gunn's DCU
item.description: We still don't know what DC Studios has planned for the wider Bat-Family, but Nightwing's big screen debut is long overdue, and any one of these actors would do right by Dick Grayson.

item.title: DOLLY Interview: Director Rod Blackhurst On Creating A New Horror Movie Icon (Exclusive)
item.description: Dolly co-writer and director Rod Blackhurst (Amanda Knox) talks to us about his bloody new slasher, revealing how he approached creating the next great horror movie icon.

item.title: THE MUMMY 4 Directors Confirm That The Franchise's Most Divisive Movie Is No Longer Canon
item.description: Scream directors Radio Silence will helm the next Mummy movie, and they've now confirmed that Tomb of the Dragon Emperor, which was missing Rachel Weisz, won't be considered canon.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumors May Reveal New Details On Doom's Followers & Possible MOM Connection - SPOILERS
item.description: We have some more Avengers: Doomsday rumors here, and this time we may have new details on how Loki will factor into the story and Doctor Doom's mysterious followers...

item.title: SCARY MOVIE Will Now Go Head-To-Head With MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE After Moving Release Date
item.description: The live-action Masters of the Universe reboot is going to have some stiff competition this summer, as Scary Movie has now moved its release date up a week...
